findings.title: Restrict the retryable error set.
findings.rationale: urllib.error.HTTPError subclasses urllib.error.URLError, so this handler retries permanent responses such as 401, 403, and 404. Handle HTTPError first, retry only approved transient status codes, and re-raise permanent HTTP errors immediately.
